message.content: {"findings": [{"cwe": "CWE-22", "class": "InputStreamHelper", "method": "writeZipStreamToTempDir", "explanation": "The entry method writeZipStreamToTempDir calls processZipStream without any path validation or sanitization, allowing attacker-controlled entry names to reach the FileOutputStream sink."}, {"cwe": "CWE-22", "class": "InputStreamHelper", "method": "processZipStream", "explanation": "In processZipStream, the tainted ZipEntry.getName() result is used directly in new File(dir, entry.getName()) and then passed to new FileOutputStream(file) without any normalization, allow-listing, or containment check, enabling path traversal."}]}
